methodology: The decomposition process involves breaking down the research topic and the generated specification into atomic units. The criteria for each unit are: independence, technical specificity, and implementability as a single requirement. The approach involves identifying key functionalities, behaviors, and constraints. For the research topic, I will extract the truth table, module definition, and the behavior description. For the generated specification, I will extract the header, combinational logic function, enhanced combinational description, interface behavior, timing dependency, and timing logic. Each atomic unit will represent a single, self-contained piece of information that can be verified or implemented independently.
